title: A perception-enhanced multi-agent deep reinforcement learning method for multi-UAV cooperative pursuit
abstract: Perception-enhanced cooperative UAV pursuit under partial observability using graph attention and Apollonius-circle pursuit judgment.

title: Causal reinforcement learning for unmanned aerial vehicle pursuit-evasion games with sparse rewards
abstract: DDPG with causal intrinsic reward and prioritized replay for sparse-reward UAV pursuit-evasion and navigation.

title: CBPE-based assignment policy for multiple player pursuit-evasion game by D3QN algorithm applied to uncrewed vehicles
abstract: D3QN-based CBPE assignment policies for multiple-player pursuit-evasion with approximate Nash-equilibrium analysis.

title: Online planning for multi-UAV pursuit-evasion in unknown environments using deep reinforcement learning
abstract: MARL-based online planning for multi-UAV pursuit-evasion in unknown environments with evader prediction enhancement and CTBR deployment.

title: Intercepting unauthorized aerial robots in controlled airspace using reinforcement learning
abstract: High-fidelity fixed-wing RL interception of dynamic evaders under diverse scenarios and perturbations.

title: A review of reinforcement learning approaches for pursuit-evasion games
abstract: Survey of reinforcement-learning approaches for pursuit-evasion games across combat, unmanned systems, and spacecraft interception.

title: A DRL framework for autonomous pursuit-evasion: from multi-spacecraft to multi-drone scenarios
abstract: Self-play PPO with curriculum learning and prediction-based reward for pursuit-evasion across spacecraft and multi-drone domains.

title: Autonomous decision making for UAV cooperative pursuit-evasion game with reinforcement learning
abstract: Cooperative multi-role UAV pursuit-evasion decision making using asynchronous DDQN with prioritized replay.

title: Emergent cooperative strategies for pursuit-evasion in cluttered environments: a knowledge-enhanced multi-agent deep reinforcement learning approach
abstract: Knowledge-enhanced MATD3 for cluttered pursuit-evasion using APF-derived cues and team rewards.

title: Vision-based cooperative MAV-capturing-MAV
abstract: Onboard-vision cooperative MAV capture with distributed estimation, MPC, and real-world net deployment.

title: Scalable Pursuit-Evasion Game for Multi-Fixed-Wing UAV Based on Dynamic Target Assignment and Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Hierarchical target assignment and reinforcement learning for scalable multi-fixed-wing pursuit-evasion.

title: Multi-UAV cooperative maneuver decision-making for pursuit-evasion using improved MADRL
abstract: Improved CommNet plus GRU communication for multi-UAV pursuit-evasion maneuver decision making.

title: Multi-USV cooperative chasing strategy based on obstacles assistance and deep reinforcement learning
abstract: Obstacle-assisted cooperative chasing with prediction and credit allocation in high-fidelity multi-USV environments.
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering

title: Learned controllers for agile quadrotors in pursuit-evasion games
abstract: Asynchronous multi-stage population-based training for agile 1v1 quadrotor pursuit-evasion with body-rate-and-thrust policies.

title: Pursuit-evasion game of unmanned tracked vehicles based on multi-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient
abstract: Zero-sum simultaneous pursuer-evader training with warning-area state compression and MATD3.

title: Learning agile quadrotor flight in the real world
abstract: Real-world online adaptation for agile quadrotor flight using adaptive temporal scaling and residual learning.

title: High-speed vision-based flight in clutter with safety-shielded reinforcement learning
abstract: Vision-based RL with physics-informed reward and model-based safety filter for high-speed cluttered flight.

title: Curriculum reinforcement learning for quadrotor racing with random obstacles
abstract: Vision-based multi-stage curriculum RL for robust obstacle-rich quadrotor racing.

title: Distributed pursuit-evasion game of limited perception USV swarm based on multiagent proximal policy optimization
abstract: MAPPO-based limited-perception pursuit with sequence encoding, barriers, and curriculum learning.
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics: Systems

title: Probabilistic pursuit-evasion games: theory, implementation, and experimental evaluation
abstract: Foundational probabilistic pursuit-evasion games with sensing-capability analysis and UAV/UGV experiments.
venue: IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Automation

title: A deep reinforcement learning-based intelligent maneuvering strategy for the high-speed UAV pursuit-evasion game
abstract: High-speed evasion strategy integrating LOS angle-rate correction with TD3 under energy and trajectory constraints.

title: High-speed autonomous flight and obstacle avoidance for quadrotors in unknown dynamic environments based on imitation learning
abstract: End-to-end trajectory-prediction network with privileged expert labels for high-speed obstacle avoidance in dynamic environments.

title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Multi-UAV Pursuit with Full Planar Motion and a Limited Detectable Region
abstract: Dec-POMDP pursuit with limited detectable region, FOV-aware rewards, and APF-based evader motion.

title: Game of Drones: Multi-UAV Pursuit-Evasion Game With Online Motion Planning by Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Obstacle-rich multi-UAV pursuit-evasion with online motion planning and target prediction network.
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

title: A Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm for Partially Observable Pursuit-Evasion Game
abstract: Partially observable pursuit-evasion with scalable deep reinforcement learning under limited sensing.

title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Pursuit Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Decentralized multi-agent pursuit with deep reinforcement learning and local observations.

title: Learning Multi-Pursuit Evasion for Safe Targeted Navigation of Drones
abstract: Asynchronous multistage deep reinforcement learning for safe drone navigation under adversarial multi-pursuer attack with physical experiments.

title: Cooperative pursuit of unauthorized UAVs in urban airspace via multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract: Urban-airspace cooperative unauthorized-UAV pursuit with multi-agent reinforcement learning.

title: A UAV pursuit-evasion strategy based on DDPG and imitation learning
abstract: Combines DDPG with imitation-learning priors for UAV pursuit-evasion strategy learning.

title: Deep reinforcement learning-driven collaborative rounding-up for multiple UAVs in obstacle environments
abstract: Collaborative rounding-up and capture of targets in obstacle environments using deep reinforcement learning.

title: Hierarchical maneuver decision method based on PG-Option for UAV pursuit-evasion game
abstract: Hierarchical option-based maneuver decision method for UAV pursuit-evasion.

title: Survey on Anti-Drone Systems: Components, Designs, and Challenges
abstract: Survey of anti-drone systems, including sensing, interception, and system-level design challenges.

title: Variable Time-Step MPC for Agile Multi-Rotor UAV Interception of Dynamic Targets
abstract: Agile model predictive control for multi-rotor UAV interception of dynamic targets using variable time steps and long planning horizons.

title: Point-based approximate algorithm for one-sided partially observable pursuit-evasion games
abstract: Point-based approximation methods for one-sided partially observable pursuit-evasion games.

title: Cooperative control for multi-player pursuit-evasion games using reinforcement learning
abstract: Reinforcement-learning-based cooperative control for multi-player pursuit-evasion games.

title: Learning High-Speed Flight in the Wild
abstract: End-to-end RL policy mapping depth images to body-rate and thrust commands for agile quadrotor flight through natural forest at up to 10 m/s. Uses 4-frame depth stack, trained with PPO purely in simulation with domain randomization, zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

title: Deep Drone Racing: From Simulation to Reality with Domain Randomization
abstract: CNN policy from stacked 4-frame depth images for autonomous drone racing. Imitation learning from expert MPC policy, then RL fine-tuning. Extensive domain randomization on depth rendering parameters enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

title: Champion-level Drone Racing using Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Vision-based end-to-end RL system defeating human world champions in physical drone racing. Combines learned visual encoder, memory module, and control module. Trained in simulation with domain randomization.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Collision-free Flight Exploiting Deep Collision Encoding
abstract: Deep Collision Encoder (DCE) compressing depth images into collision-aware latent via self-supervised auxiliary collision prediction. Encoder pretrained and frozen, latent fed to RL policy. Built on the Aerial Gym Simulator.

title: Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion over Challenging Terrain
abstract: Teacher-student framework: teacher trained with privileged terrain information, student learns from depth and proprioception. Student runs onboard in real-time. Zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

title: Learning by Cheating
abstract: Privileged agent (full state and map) trained first; vision-based sensor agent distilled via online DAgger-style imitation. Formulates privileged-to-sensor transition as 'learning by cheating'.

title: Asymmetric Actor Critic for Image-Based Robot Learning
abstract: Asymmetric actor-critic architecture where actor receives only images (no privileged state) but critic receives full privileged state during training. Critic provides better gradients without privileged info at deployment.

title: RMA: Rapid Motor Adaptation for Legged Robots
abstract: Two-stage framework: teacher trained with privileged environment info, student adaptation module infers privileged latent from proprioception history. No depth/vision, uses proprioception and action history.

title: DroNet: Learning to Fly by Driving
abstract: Imitation learning from car driving data for drone collision avoidance. Uses single RGB camera. Demonstrates cross-domain transfer from cars to drones.

title: Reinforcement Learning with Unsupervised Auxiliary Tasks
abstract: UNREAL agent learns auxiliary control and reward prediction tasks alongside main RL objective. Auxiliary tasks shape shared representation, improving data efficiency and final performance.

title: Learning to be Safe: Deep RL with a Safety Critic
abstract: Learns a binary safety critic predicting probability of entering dangerous states, trained from offline trajectories. The safety critic constrains exploration during online RL on new tasks. Tested on navigation, locomotion, and manipulation.

title: Failure-Aware RL: Reliable Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning with Self-Recovery for Real-World Manipulation
abstract: World-model-based safety critic trained offline to predict Intervention-requiring Failures. During online RL, safety critic detects impending failures and triggers recovery. 73.1% reduction in IR failures on real robots.

title: Recovery RL: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Learned Recovery Zones
abstract: Learns to predict unsafe states (recovery zones) from offline data, then uses separate recovery policy when agent enters predicted unsafe regions. Binary safety classifier trained offline, integrated into online RL via policy switching.

title: Learning Vision-based Pursuit-Evasion Robot Policies
abstract: Transforms pursuit-evasion into teacher-student problem: fully-observable privileged teacher generates supervision for partially-observable vision-based student. Student learns to gather information when uncertain and anticipate to intercept. Deployed on physical quadruped with RGB-D.

title: Control Strategies for Pursuit-Evasion Under Occlusion Using Visibility and Safety Barrier Functions
abstract: Visibility-based CBFs to keep evader within pursuer's FoV despite occlusions. Signed distance functions of FoV as CBF constraints. Sampling-based kinodynamic planner for non-myopic pursuit under occlusion.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Collision Avoidance
abstract: Uses MC dropout to estimate predictive uncertainty of dynamics model, then uses uncertainty as collision risk signal for action selection. Uncertainty to risk proxy to control pipeline.

title: Estimating Risk and Uncertainty in Deep Reinforcement Learning
venue: ICML Workshop on Uncertainty and Robustness in Deep Learning
abstract: Framework for disentangling epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty in learned Q-values. Derives unbiased uncertainty estimators. Proposes uncertainty-aware DQN algorithm with safe learning behavior.

title: A Multiplicative Value Function for Safe and Efficient Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Factorizes value function into safety critic (constraint violation probability) and reward critic (constraint-free returns). Multiplicative decomposition allows policy to trade off risk against reward. Zero-shot sim-to-real.

title: Accelerating Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Datasets
abstract: Uses offline data to pretrain policies via advantage-weighted regression (AWAC), then fine-tunes online. Shows dramatic sample efficiency gains from offline pretraining.

title: CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Contrastive learning (SimCLR-style) for visual RL representations. Learns image representations via instance discrimination before/alongside RL training.

title: Pretraining Representations for Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Self-supervised pretraining of visual representations for RL using temporal contrastive learning (SPR). Frozen or fine-tuned pretrained encoder dramatically improves sample efficiency in online RL.

title: Safe Exploration in Continuous Action Spaces
abstract: Safety layer that analytically solves a QP to minimally perturb RL policy action to satisfy safety constraints. Safety layer is a differentiable projection: argmin ||u - u_rl||^2 s.t. C(u) <= 0.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Shielding
abstract: Shield that monitors RL agent's action and overrides it when it would violate temporal logic safety specification. Shield is pre-computed from safety specs. Least-restrictive shield concept.

title: Learning for Safety-Critical Control with Control Barrier Functions
abstract: Learning-based framework for CBFs: learns system model and uses it to construct CBF safety filters. Combines model learning with barrier-certified safety.

title: End-to-End Safe Reinforcement Learning through Barrier Functions for Safety-Critical Continuous Control Tasks
abstract: Integrates CBFs directly into RL: CBF-based safety controller intervenes during exploration and policy updates. Combines model-free RL with model-based CBFs for guaranteed safety during training.

title: Constrained Policy Optimization
abstract: CPO: constrained policy optimization with trust-region guarantees. First principled algorithm for policy gradient under safety constraints (cost limits). max J(pi) s.t. D(pi) <= d.

title: Benchmarking Safe Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Standardized benchmark suite (Safety Gym) for safe RL. Formalizes cost-constrained MDPs with collision avoidance and goal-reaching. Introduces CPO, PPO-Lagrangian, TRPO-Lagrangian baselines.

title: Multi-UAV Cooperative Pursuit Strategy With Limited Visual Field in Urban Airspace: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
abstract: Multi-UAV pursuit-evasion under limited visual field, perception distance, viewing angle, and urban obstruction. Proposes NAGC with a normalizing-flow actor and obstacle-target graph attention critic for search, pursuit, and reacquisition.

title: Safe Cooperative Decision-Making for Multi-UAV Pursuit-Evasion Games via Opponent Intent Inference
abstract: Cooperative multi-UAV pursuit-evasion under occlusion, sensor noise, and intermittent observability. Uses behavior-mode and subgoal inference, length-agnostic trajectory prediction, belief-risk-gated hierarchical SAC, and a safety projection layer.

title: Cooperative Bearing-Only Target Pursuit via Multiagent Reinforcement Learning: Design and Experiment
abstract: Multi-robot target pursuit with bearing-only sensing, a uniform bearing-only information filter, target-loss resilience under limited FoV, and multiagent RL pursuit control.
